_README: Copy to config/profile.json (gitignored) and edit. Only keys you change are needed; the rest fall back to betlab/profile.py DEFAULTS.
_unit_note: 1 unit = 1% of bankroll. Units are a display convenience; stakes come from fractional Kelly + caps.
_min_ev_note: EV thresholds apply AFTER blending the model with the devigged market price.
_model_weight_note: Weight on YOUR model vs the market in logit space. Raise only after your CLV proves the model adds information. NFL is 0: the NFL ratings lose to closing lines in walk-forward tests (2021-25).
_quiet_day_note: Opt-in. On a day with no value bet, name the one single bet closest to the sharp fair price, labelled entertainment, not value, at stake_pct of bankroll; none if even that costs more than max_cost_pct. Log it with --tier entertainment so it stays out of the skill record (python3 -m betlab quietday).
